muscles.name: Upper Chest
muscles.description: Inclined push or elbow moves from high to low.

muscles.name: Mid Chest
muscles.description: Straight push or elbow moves from back to front.

muscles.name: Lower Chest
muscles.description: Downward push or elbow moves from low to high.

muscles.name: Lats
muscles.description: Pulling arms down or elbows toward hips.

muscles.name: Upper Back
muscles.description: Pulling shoulder blades together.

muscles.name: Traps
muscles.description: Lifting shoulders back and upwards.

muscles.name: Lower Back
muscles.description: Moving upper torso back upright.

muscles.name: Front Delt
muscles.description: Pressing arms forward or overhead.

muscles.name: Side Delt
muscles.description: Raising arms out to the sides.

muscles.name: Rear Delt
muscles.description: Pulling arms back or rowing high to the chest.

muscles.name: Quadriceps
muscles.description: Extend knees forward, squats or presses.

muscles.name: Hamstrings
muscles.description: Bend knees back or hinge at hips.

muscles.name: Glutes
muscles.description: Push hips back, then drive forward.

muscles.name: Abductors
muscles.description: Push knees or legs outward.

muscles.name: Adductors
muscles.description: Pull knees or legs inward.

muscles.name: Calves
muscles.description: Raise heels off the ground.

muscles.name: Shins
muscles.description: Lift toes toward shins or control foot descent.

muscles.name: Upper Abs
muscles.description: Curling shoulders towards hips.

muscles.name: Lower Abs
muscles.description: Lifting knees or tilting hips up to torso.

muscles.name: Obliques
muscles.description: Twisting or bending of torso side to side.

muscles.name: Biceps Long Head
muscles.description: Elbows behind with a deep bottom stretch.

muscles.name: Biceps Short Head
muscles.description: Elbows in front with a strong top squeeze.

muscles.name: Triceps Lateral Head
muscles.description: Push arms outwards, elbows close to sides.

muscles.name: Triceps Long Head
muscles.description: Arms raised overhead or move inwards.

muscles.name: Triceps Medial Head
muscles.description: Movements where arms will fully straighten.

muscles.name: Brachioradialis
muscles.description: Curling with neutral, hammer-style grip.

muscles.name: Extensors
muscles.description: Lifting back of hand or resisting wrist bend.

muscles.name: Flexors
muscles.description: Hard gripping or curling the wrist inwards.
